title: Conductor Data
description: Conductor construction, DC resistance, short-circuit and voltage-drop reference tables (General DB-backed + Industrial static).
notes: Do not blind-merge industrial and general sources — they are separate legacy pages.
Industrial (content-ind_conductor_data.php): static construction + DC resistance + correction factors.
General (content-conductor_data.php): values from MySQL tc.conductor_data (unit=M and unit=AWG), promoted Phase 4B.
Temperature correction factors match between both pages.
Legacy General construction/SCC UI skipped metric CSA > 630; all 24 metric source rows are retained here.

shortCircuitFormulas.title: Conductor Size - Short Circuit Rating
shortCircuitFormulas.description: The short circuit current ratings in this catalogue are based on a one second duration. To calculate the maximum permissible short circuit ratings, the following formulas should be applied.
notes: C = cross section area of conductor in mm² (or MCM for MCM formulas)
t = short circuit time in seconds
